results.name: input_device_find_by_name
results.evidence: Iterates a device-name table (DAT_0065b988, stride 3) via repeated calls to FUN_00625430 until a match is found or the table end (0x65b9b7) is reached, then calls FUN_00491480 to resolve a handle for the matched name and stores it through param_1.
results.summary: Searches a table of device name strings for a match, resolves the matched entry to a handle via FUN_00491480, and returns the table index (or 0xffff on failure).

results.name: input_device_get_axis_count
results.evidence: Maps a device index (in_CX) through the slot table DAT_006b2ce8 (initialized to -1 for 'unused' in FUN_00491a80) and, if mapped, reads a dword from a 0x240-byte-stride device struct array (DAT_006b1a9c); two neighboring functions in this file read the next two consecutive dwords of the same struct (0x1aa0, 0x1aa4), matching a DirectInput DIDEVCAPS-style dwAxes/dwButtons/dwPOVs triple.
results.summary: Returns the first of three consecutive capability fields (interpreted as axis count) from the input device struct mapped to the given slot index, or 0 if unmapped.

results.name: input_device_get_button_count
results.evidence: Identical pattern to FUN_00491610 but reads the next dword (DAT_006b1aa0, +4 bytes) of the same per-device struct, consistent with a DIDEVCAPS-style dwButtons field following dwAxes.
results.summary: Returns the second of three consecutive capability fields (interpreted as button count) from the input device struct mapped to the given slot index, or 0 if unmapped.

results.name: input_device_get_pov_count
results.evidence: Identical pattern to FUN_00491610/630 but reads the third consecutive dword (DAT_006b1aa4, +8 bytes) of the same per-device struct, consistent with a DIDEVCAPS-style dwPOVs field.
results.summary: Returns the third of three consecutive capability fields (interpreted as POV-hat count) from the input device struct mapped to the given slot index, or 0 if unmapped.

results.name: input_guid_parse_ansi
results.evidence: Converts an ANSI string (unaff_ESI) to a wide-char buffer and calls the imported CLSIDFromString on it, returning success based on the HRESULT sign -- a direct GUID-string-to-CLSID parser.
results.summary: Converts an ANSI device-id string to UTF-16 and parses it into a CLSID via CLSIDFromString, returning whether the parse succeeded.

results.name: input_device_find_index_by_guid
results.evidence: Walks the registered-device array (DAT_006b1a74, stride 0x240, count DAT_006b1844) comparing a 16-byte key at param_1+0x20c against each entry's first 16 bytes (a GUID), with a quick pre-check field at piVar2[4] against param_1+0x21c; returns the matching slot index or 0xffffffff.
results.summary: Finds the index of the registered input device whose GUID matches the one embedded in the given struct, or 0xffffffff if none match.

results.name: input_device_list_print
results.evidence: Referenced format string '%d) deviceid %s - %s'; iterates the registered device array (DAT_006b1868, count DAT_006b1844), converts each entry's GUID via StringFromGUID2 and its name field to ANSI, and logs each line through FUN_00496a80.
results.summary: Enumerates all registered input devices and logs each one's index, GUID string, and device name.

results.name: input_keyboard_device_create
results.evidence: Referenced strings 'CreateDevice (keyboard)', 'SetDataFormat (keyboard)', 'SetCooperativeLevel (keyboard)', 'SetProperty (keyboard)' each labeling the corresponding failed DirectInput call (CreateDevice, SetDataFormat, SetCooperativeLevel, SetProperty on DAT_006b1800).
results.summary: Creates and configures the DirectInput keyboard device object (data format, cooperative level, buffered-input property), logging and cleaning up on any failure.

results.name: input_mouse_device_create
results.evidence: Referenced strings 'CreateDevice (mouse)', 'SetCooperativeLevel (mouse)', 'SetDataFormat (mouse)' labeling each failed DirectInput call; also queries GetSystemMetrics(SM_SWAPBUTTON) to set the button-swap mapping (DAT_0068e534/536) before creating the device.
results.summary: Creates and configures the DirectInput mouse device object, first determining left/right button swap state from the system settings, logging and cleaning up on any failure.

results.name: input_system_initialize
results.evidence: Initializes the 128-entry keyboard action table (DAT_00879f64), a secondary table (DAT_0087a164), a larger table (DAT_0087a264) to 'unbound' sentinels, clears the per-device-slot struct array (DAT_006b1a98..0x6b2c98, stride 0x240) to -1, registers a device-list-change notification on DAT_006b15fc, and resets the device-slot mapping array DAT_006b2ce8 used throughout this file.
results.summary: One-time initialization of the input subsystem: clears all action-binding tables and per-device state, and registers for DirectInput device-change notifications.

results.name: input_mouse_state_process
results.evidence: Copies dx from a raw input struct (in_ECX) while negating dy and dz/DAT_006b1808 into the output struct, then loops 8 times over the button-swap-sized array DAT_0068e534 building per-button hold-duration counters (clamped to 0xff) and a 'changed' flag byte -- matches a normalized mouse-state update.
results.summary: Converts a raw mouse delta/button sample into the engine's normalized mouse state, inverting the Y axis, scaling the Z axis, and tracking per-button hold duration and change flags.

results.name: input_device_count_by_guid
results.evidence: Same registered-device array/stride (DAT_006b1a74, 0x90 dwords, count DAT_006b1844) and 16-byte GUID compare as FUN_004916e0, but tallies the number of matches instead of returning the first index.
results.summary: Counts how many registered input devices have a GUID matching the one supplied.

results.name: input_device_release
results.evidence: Given a device slot index (unaff_SI), if the device pointer array DAT_006b1848 has a non-null entry it calls vtable+0x20 (Unacquire-style) then vtable+8 (Release-style), nulls the pointer, and zero-fills the corresponding 0x240-byte struct in DAT_006b1868 -- the same struct/stride used by the device-enumeration functions in this file.
results.summary: Unacquires and releases the DirectInput device object at the given slot index and clears its cached device-info struct.

results.name: input_joystick_state_process
results.evidence: First loop builds per-key hold-duration counters from a pressed-bit (bit 0x80) array, matching the pattern in FUN_00491bc0; second loop quantizes a POV value (0..0x83d6, i.e. hundredths of a degree) into an 8-direction index using thresholds spaced ~0x1194 (4500 = 45 degrees) apart, the classic DirectInput POV-to-octant conversion; third loop copies raw 16-bit axis/button values through unchanged.
results.summary: Normalizes a raw joystick/device sample into the engine's input state: computes button hold-duration counters, quantizes POV hat values into 8 directional zones, and passes through raw axis values.

results.name: input_error_log_once
results.evidence: Takes an error code and a format string (matching the 'CreateDevice (keyboard/mouse)' etc. strings passed from FUN_004918a0/FUN_004919c0); only formats via vsprintf when the code differs from the last-logged code cached in DAT_0068e544, avoiding duplicate spam.
results.summary: Formats and (de-duplicated by error code) logs a DirectInput failure message, given an HRESULT-like code and a printf-style description.

results.name: main_menu_music_start
results.evidence: The prior 'chimera__' prefix is a hint-only marker per project convention and must be replaced; code looks up the title-music tag and detaches any active looping sound when a flag (DAT_00718fc6) is set, cancels any pending 'ending.bik' playback via FUN_0043ed20, optionally resets the rasterizer device, then calls main_menu_play_title_music() to (re)start the menu music -- the name's semantic content ('main menu music') is retained since the code agrees with it.
results.summary: Stops any currently playing title music/video state and (re)starts the main menu's looping title music track.

results.name: input_queue_timestamp_sample
results.evidence: Samples QueryPerformanceCounter, converts to milliseconds via __allmul/__alldiv against the DAT_006ac8f8/fc frequency, and stores the result in DAT_00712c34, a global read/written by the neighboring input-queue functions in this file (FUN_00492250/4922b0/492340).
results.summary: Samples the high-resolution performance counter and stores the current time in milliseconds into a global timestamp used by the nearby input-queue routines.

results.name: input_queue_initialize
results.evidence: Zero-fills the 0x10c-byte region at DAT_00712cc0, then samples QueryPerformanceCounter into DAT_00712cc4/cc8 and sets the enable flag DAT_00712cc0=1 -- consistent with initializing the queue state that FUN_004922b0 (pop) and FUN_00492340 (push) subsequently operate on.
results.summary: Clears and enables the input event queue, seeding its timestamp fields with the current time.

results.name: input_queue_pop_entry
results.evidence: Guarded by the enable flag DAT_00712cc0 set by FUN_00492250; for a given type/index it scans 8 slots of a per-type array (DAT_006b1... no -- DAT_00712d04 region) for a non-zero entry, copies its two stored dwords (DAT_00712ccc/cd0) to the output and clears it; when param_2 is -1 it recursively tries all 4 types.
results.summary: Pops the next queued input entry for a given type (or scans all 4 types when none is specified), returning its stored data pair and clearing the slot.

results.name: input_queue_push_entry
results.evidence: Guarded by !DAT_00712cc1; samples the current time, shifts the DAT_00712ccc/cd4 ring buffer for the given type (in_AX) via _memmove to make room, inserts the new entry from unaff_EDI, and updates the last-event timestamp DAT_00712cc4 when the event id is non-zero.
results.summary: Pushes a new timestamped entry into the input event queue for a given type, shifting older entries to make room.
